In den Briefdaten gibt es das Feld <i>„A: The letter details include the “Case file” field, e.g. “Müller v. Schmidt” or “Meier – Income Tax 2025”. PDFMy suggests the case file itself: if a letter has the same reference number as one filed earlier, it belongs in the same case file – otherwise the sender’s most recent case file is used. In Incoming mail log & case files (More → Office), the “Case files” view shows each case file with the number of documents, open items, the next deadline and the people responsible. “Show documents” filters the list to that case file; “Open case file” opens all documents in the case file, sorted by date, as a single document – for reading, printing or saving together (with a connected filing folder). You assign previously filed letters in the “Case file” column of the list; filters for case file and year help you search. The case file is also included in the incoming mail log’s Excel file.
